WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM film f
  JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(film_count) as avg_films FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.film_count > ac.avg_films THEN rc.film_count ELSE 0 END) as total_films_above_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN rc.film_count > ac.avg_films THEN rc.film_count - ac.avg_films ELSE NULL END) as avg_excess
FROM rating_counts rc, avg_count ac
